Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

FLATBREAD WITH BUTTER CHICKEN #food #recipe #chicken #butterchicken #flatbread CHICKEN MIXTURE 25 g unsalted butter 20 ml sunflower oil 600 g chicken thighs, cut into cubes 5 g garam masala (1⅔ tsp) 2 g ground coriander (⅔ tsp) 2 g ground cumin (⅔ tsp) 3 g garlic powder (1 tsp) 4 g onion powder (1⅓ tsp) 2 g cayenne pepper (⅔ tsp) 30 g tomato paste 50 ml water 100 ml heavy cream 15 g honey 1 chicken stock cube 100 g grated cheese (Gouda) DOUGH 350 g all-purpose flour 50 g herb cream cheese 4 g salt (⅔ tsp) 6 g baking powder 170 ml water EXTRA cheese slices Heat the butter and sunflower oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken thighs, garam masala, ground coriander, ground cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne pepper. Fry for 5–6 minutes. Add the tomato paste, water, cream, and honey. Mix well and let simmer for 5–7 minutes until the sauce has slightly thickened. Crumble the chicken stock cube over the pan. Add the grated cheese and stir until creamy. Remove from the heat and let the chicken mixture cool completely. Place the flour, baking powder, herb cream cheese, salt, and water in a large bowl. Knead for 10–12 minutes until smooth. Cover and let the dough rest for 10 minutes. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces of about 70 g each and shape into balls. Roll out a dough ball into a circle. Place a slice of cheese on one half and spread about 90 g of the chicken mixture on top. Lightly moisten the edges, fold the dough closed, and press the edges firmly to seal. Place the filled dough on a sheet of parchment paper. Heat a heavy-bottomed frying pan with a little oil. Cook the breads over medium-high heat until golden brown and cooked through on both sides. Tips Don’t cut the chicken too small. Cubes of about 2 cm give a better bite. Let the mixture thicken well. The sauce should be creamy and firm, not runny like a curry. Let it cool completely. A warm filling makes the dough soft and hard to seal. Letting the dough rest is important. Those 10 minutes make it more elastic and easier to roll out. Use any cheese you like. You can also bake these breads in the oven. Preheat the oven to 200°C (390°F) and bake for 15–20 minutes (brush with oil or butter). Add salt to taste. Preparation Time Chicken mixture preparation & cooling: 20 minutes Dough preparation & resting: 25 minutes Cooking: 10–15 minutes

MARRY ME MASH 🥔✨ Recipe below ⬇️ This is the ultimate recipe for luxurious mashed potato. Ultra-smooth, buttery, garlic-thyme infused, finished with white pepper and nutmeg. Make no mistake - this is pure indulgence, and it will make your guests so silent at the table. Marry Me Mash: Peel and cube 1kg Maris Piper potatoes. Add to cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer gently until completely tender. Drain and leave to steam dry for 20-30 minutes (this step is key for texture). Meanwhile, gently simmer 200ml whole milk and 200ml double cream with 4 chopped garlic cloves and 3-4 thyme sprigs for 30 minutes to infuse. Strain and keep warm. Pass the dried potatoes through a ricer, then fold through 150g melted butter. For extra smoothness, push through a fine mesh sieve. Add the warm infused cream one ladle at a time until silky and smooth but still holding its shape. Season with fine salt, white pepper and a small grating of nutmeg. Taste and adjust. Bonus recipe - Braised Short Rib (perfect with this mash): Season 3-4 large beef short ribs generously with salt and pepper and sear in a hot casserole pot with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned. Remove. In the same pot soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato purée, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 3 thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Deglaze with 500ml red wine, reduce slightly, then add enough beef stock (around 750ml-1L) to fully submerge the ribs. Return the ribs, cover and cook at 130°C for 4 hours until spoon tender. Remove the ribs, strain and remove the fat from the sauce (use a separator jug if you have one). Pass through a fine sieve and then reduce it until glossy and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Return the ribs to the sauce and baste. Silky mash. Sticky, rich beef. Absolute comfort food - elevated. #mash #shortrib #cooking #recipe #food

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Birria ramen ✨ Ingredients  For the Meat - 2.5 - 3lbs beef chuck roast  - Salt & pepper to taste (season generously) - 1 tbsp oil (for searing) Sauce - 5 dried guajillo chilies - 4 dried pasilla chilies  - 4-5 chile de arbol - 1 large red onion(halved) - 1 whole head of garlic, peeled  - 3 Roma tomatoes, sliced  -  1 tbsp tomato paste  - 1/3 cup chipotle peppers (adjust to spice preference) - 1 tbsp ground cumin - 2 tsp chili powder  - 2 tsp dried oregano  - 2 tsp smoked paprika  - 2 tsp ground coriander  - 1 tsp garlic powder  - 1 tsp onion powder  - 1 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp beef bouillon powder  - 1/2 tsp allspice  - 2 cinnamon sticks  -  2-3 whole cloves -  2 bay leaves -  1 tbsp apple cider vinegar - Salt to taste - 2 cups beef stock for cooking - 5 cups water (2 for steeping chiles and vegetables, 3 for cooking) Ramen  - Ramen noodles - Chopped red onion - Fresh cilantro - Shredded Oaxaca or mozzarella cheese  -  Lime wedges - Jalepeno slices - 2 cups water - 1 cup birria consommé, plus extra for serving  Instructions  - Cut beef into large chunks. Season generously with salt and pepper. - In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat oil over medium-high heat. - Sear meat in batches until browned on all sides. Remove and set aside. - Remove stems and seeds from dried chilies. - In a same pot you seared meat in add onion, garlic, and tomatoes. Cook until slightly browned and fragrant about 2-3 minutes.  - Add chiles and mix until well combined. Cook until fragrant about 30-40 seconds  - Cover with water and simmer for 10 minutes, or until everything is soft. - Transfer the softened ingredients to a blender. Add salt, apple cider vinegar, chipotle peppers and a cup of water. Blend until smooth. - Strain the sauce through a sieve for a smoother consomé (optional but recommended). - Return seared meat to the pot. Pour the blended sauce over the meat. - Add remaining beef broth and water to just cover the meat. Add salt and seasonings to taste. - Simmer covered on low for 3–4 hours, or until the meat is fork-tender (or 1 hour in a pressure cooker/Instant Pot, or 6–8 hours in a slow cooker on low). - Once cooked, shred the meat and return to the broth. - In a small pot, bring 2 cups water + 1 cup birria consommé to a boil. - Add the ramen noodles and seasoning packet, then cook according to the package instructions, stirring occasionally, until the noodles are tender. - Transfer the ramen to a bowl and top with shredded cheese. Pour a little extra hot birria consommé over the top - Add diced red onion, and fresh cilantro. Finish with a squeeze of fresh lime and enjoy • • • #recipe #fallrecipes #recipeideas #birria #ramen

Cozy Dinner 🍂 One-Pan Marry Me Chicken Meatball Pasta 🤍 Ingredients: Chicken Meatballs:  • 1 lb ground chicken • ⅓ cup seasoned breadcrumbs • 3 tbsp milk • ¼ cup Parmesan • 1 egg • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 2 tbsp fresh basil, chopped • 1 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped • 1½ tsp Spice Islands Garlic & Herb All Purpose Seasoning • ½ tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1 tbsp olive oil, for searing Pasta:  • 12 oz orecchiette • 1 tbsp butter • 1 shallot, diced • 3 garlic cloves, minced • ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp garlic powder • ¼ tsp red pepper flakes, optional • 4 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream, divided • ½ cup Parmesan • 2 cups spinach • Fresh basil + parsley • Salt + pepper, to taste Directions: • Mix breadcrumbs + milk and let sit 2–3 minutes. Add remaining meatball ingredients and gently combine. • Roll into mini meatballs. Sear in olive oil until golden, then remove and set aside. • In the same pot, melt butter and sauté shallot. Add garlic, sun-dried tomatoes, seasonings. • Add chicken broth + ½ cup heavy cream. Bring to a gentle boil, add orecchiette and reduce to a simmer. • After 5 minutes, add meatballs back in. Simmer uncovered another 7–10 minutes, stirring often, until pasta is al dente and meatballs reach 165°F. Add a splash of broth if needed. • Reduce heat to low and stir in remaining ½ cup heavy cream, Parmesan, spinach, basil + parsley. • Stir until extra creamy and saucy. 🍰 High-Protein Greek Yogurt Cheesecake Protein-packed, creamy, and incredibly easy to make. You’ll need: • 28 oz (800 g) full-fat Greek yogurt • 2 eggs • 4 tbsp semolina (or 3 tbsp cornstarch) • 1 tbsp vanilla extract • Sweetener, to taste • Fresh berries How to make it: 1. Preheat the oven to 390°F (200°C). 2. Whisk together the yogurt, eggs, vanilla, semolina, and sweetener until smooth. 3. Fold in the berries. 4. Pour into a parchment-lined baking dish. 5. Bake for 35–45 minutes, until lightly golden. 6. Cool completely, then chill for at least 2 hours before serving. ✨ Tip: It tastes even better the next day! 💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

Recipe Name Slow Cooker Pulled Beef Roast Ingredients 1. 4 lb beef chuck roast 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp brown sugar 4. 1 tbsp smoked paprika 5. 2 tsp garlic powder 6. 2 tsp onion powder 7. 1 tsp chili powder 8. 1 tsp ground cumin 9. 1 tsp black pepper 10. 1 tsp salt 11. 1 cup barbecue sauce 12. 1/2 cup beef broth 13. 1/4 cup Worcestershire sauce 14. 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar 15. 2 tbsp honey 16. 4 cloves garlic, minced 17. 1 medium onion, diced Recipe 1. Pat the beef chuck roast dry with paper towels. 2. Combine brown sugar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, chili powder, cumin, black pepper, and salt. 3. Rub the spice mixture thoroughly over every side of the roast. 4. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 5. Sear the roast for 3–4 minutes per side until deeply browned. 6. Place the diced onion and minced garlic in the bottom of a slow cooker. 7. Set the seared beef roast on top of the onions and garlic. 8. Whisk together barbecue sauce, beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, apple cider vinegar, and honey. 9. Pour the sauce over the roast, making sure it is well coated. 10. Cover and cook on LOW for 8–9 hours or until the beef is tender enough to pull apart easily. 11. Carefully transfer the cooked roast to a large bowl and shred it with two forks. 12. Return the shredded beef to the slow cooker and mix it thoroughly with the cooking juices. 13. Cook uncovered for another 15–20 minutes so the meat absorbs the rich sauce. 14. Spoon the caramelized sauce over the shredded beef before serving. 15. Serve hot on toasted buns, over mashed potatoes, with rice, or alongside roasted vegetables.
